name: zvideo_dd_zbuffer_depth_fill_rect
description: zVideo_dd::ZBuffer_DepthFillRect clears the current DirectDraw Z-buffer rectangle with DDBLT_DEPTHFILL, skips when no Z-buffer surface is installed, and retries after a successful Restore on DDERR_SURFACELOST.
